bounded_launcher_follow_up.documented_semantics: The default prompt is the mode name; --search separately specifies an initial search. The packaged command supplies --show but no --search.
bounded_launcher_follow_up.diagnosis: A default prompt could explain the displayed word; it does not prove why Ctrl+A was reported necessary. No failure is reclassified and no runtime command is changed by this receipt.
bounded_launcher_follow_up.next_observation: Open untouched Super+Space and type chromium without Ctrl+A, Backspace or other clearing. Capture whether drun disappears or becomes part of the query, whether Chromium is found and whether Enter launches it.
